method: Renders r_head (q02-q05 930x575, s1-s6/v1-v4 640x480) vs omaat_f5, f7, f9, f11, f13, f32, f57, f58, f60. Scale from the 43in glass (0.952 x 0.535 m). PIL box means; colours compared as ratios inside one image because studio and cabin light differ from the photos. Code: src/09d_suite.js at head (292 lines).

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b HIGH: centre aisle pier 0.085 m with a 0.035 slot mirror
calibration.status: fixed (mostly). l.52 puts the centre screen against the board and l.78 sets pAng 70, so pw = 0.19 and mW = 0.13. q02 2D now shows a full pill mirror. Mirror height/screen height is 0.64 vs 0.68 in f32, but mirror width/screen height is 0.22 vs 0.37, so the pier still reads narrower than f32/f5.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b HIGH/MED: closed-door variant showed five fluted leaves
calibration.status: fixed. v1 has two ~0.50 leaves meeting mid-opening, 8 mm proud, with recessed double pulls and dark-wood flanks (l.203-204, 219-222), as in f60.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b MED: 0.10-0.15 band between the leaf top and the cap
calibration.status: fixed. l.201: ly1 = H-0.015 with 0.035 rails. The leaf now tucks under the cap in s6/v1 (f60, f7).

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a MED: keypad reads as white tiles
calibration.status: fixed in q02 (keypad/console 1.02 vs real 1.0-1.1) and s5 (1.14). q04 still reads 1.6 (198/122), a specular/sun-LUT effect on the 12-degree tilted panel: lighting, noted only.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b MED: window wing was a 0.04-0.05 sliver
calibration.status: fixed. l.50/60-63 make a 0.10 extruded wing with an r 0.08 corner. In q03 it is 35/317 px = 0.105 m with the rounded corner visible; f11 gives 0.13-0.15, close enough.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b MED: bed duvet a narrow 0.42 slab
calibration.status: fixed (mostly). l.249-253: SW-0.07 wide over the foot 1.30 with an aisle drape. The turned-down corner (l.252, 0.014 thick) still reads as a single pencil line in q04.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a MED: half-cylinder ribs read as pinstripes
calibration.status: fixed. l.209 uses flat 0.020 slats with 0.006 grooves. Grazing-angle moire remains (s1 forward leaf, q05): see issues.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6b MED: bezel poked 0.0175 into the cap (no rim)
calibration.status: fixed. Bezel top 0.965+0.2775 = 1.2425 sits flush under the 0.04 cap (l.43, 52). Rim about 0.04, f11 0.036.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a LOW: screen-wall cap too tall
w6a LOW: protruding silver door pulls
calibration.status: fixed (l.216-217: body-colour pull with a black pocket).

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a LOW: centre headrest flap 89 % of the back

calibration.status: fixed (l.13 fMirror #4a545a, m 0.5). It renders #36424c in q03, a touch blue but plausible.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a LOW: wardrobe safety-card door short, pull missing

calibration.status: partly fixed. l.72-73 use 0.018 strips, but q02 still shows a dashed dark seam down the 2D/2G fin's aft edge. The rounded edges of the two mirrored units' strips meet back-to-back at the shared plane and leave a sub-pixel groove.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6b LOW: extra taupe post on the raised divider
w6b LOW: niche header thin, square inner corners
calibration.status: not fixed (l.238 still 0.075, square). f9 header is about 0.13 with ~0.06 fillets.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6b LOW: reading lamp touching the pier edge
calibration.status: regressed in a new way. l.87 keeps the lamp at pw-0.05 (now clear of the edge), but the wider mirror (l.84 mW 0.13 at mX = pw/2) runs under it. In q03 the lamp ring sits on the mirror's upper-outer corner, and on 2D (q02) it touches the mirror's top corner.

calibration.earlier_issue: w6b LOW: fluted field warm brown, real olive taupe
calibration.status: not fixed (SEATMAT.fFlute #5a5347; v1 field #776a57, R-B 32 vs f60 #494936, R-B 19).

calibration.earlier_issue: w6a/w6b out of scope: cream shells / bright sidewall, sun patches
calibration.status: not fixed (lighting owner). q02 cap reads blue-grey #7c8e97 from sky light.

omaat_f60. The mechanism and layout are right. The wood flanks are too light against the fluted field (wood/field 0.62 vs 0.39 in f60), and the field is too warm.

omaat_f32, f33, f13. The board and its taupe edges read right from the aisle. There is a dashed seam on the aft edge. f13 (from the screen wall looking aft) shows two boards splayed into a V that opens forward, not one in-plane board: see questions.
f_17314, tpa_IMG_0220. A uniform wood face with one taupe post near the fin and a thin rail. Acceptable.

details.refs: omaat_f9, f13. Flap/back 1.09 vs 1.19, pillow/back 1.35 vs 1.35, niche/back 1.08 vs 1.05. The channel seams render as LIGHT hairlines (fInner on a darker back); the real seams are dark creases. The back has a faint mauve cast (#635b61) vs warm grey #7f7870.

omaat_f9, f13, f5. The door frame size and taupe pull now match.

code review, l.282-291. It does not match the near model, so it pops when crossing the 9.5 m LOD distance.

issues.issue: The pier reading lamp overlaps the vanity mirror's upper-outer corner (window and centre suites). It is very visible in the seated hero view q03.
issues.evidence: q03 crop: the lamp ring sits on the mirror rim at its top-right corner. The code agrees: window pw = 0.203, mirror x 0.03..0.16 (mX = pw/2-0.005, mW 0.13), top y 1.185; the lamp is centred at x 0.153, y 1.15, r 0.037, so they intersect. Centre pw = 0.19 behaves the same way. omaat_f11 / f5: the mirror sits on the screen side of the pier and the lamp on the outer side, clear of it.
issues.fix: src/09d_suite.js l.84: const mW = Math.min(0.13, pw - 0.10), mX = 0.015 + mW / 2; (window: mirror 0.015..0.118, about 0.10 x 0.44; centre 0.015..0.105). l.87: spot(pt(pw - 0.042, H - 0.09, 0.02, 0, Math.PI / 2)), so the lamp spans pw-0.079..pw-0.005, with >= 6 mm of wood between it and the mirror.

issues.issue: The far LOD suite (suiteFar) disagrees with the near model, so suites pop as the camera crosses the 9.5 m LOD distance (looking forward from THE Room). Centre suites get a FULL-HEIGHT divider though the default is lowered. The screen is at x -0.05 for every suite (near: wing+0.488 / against the board). There are no fluted leaves, caps or pier.
issues.evidence: l.288: height opts.center ? H : 0.7, where the near default DH = 0.70 (l.114). l.290: screen at -0.05, y 0.96, z -L+0.151; near scx = -0.012 (window) / -0.048 (centre), y 0.965, z -L+0.141. 09_seats.js l.234-235 swap to suiteFar beyond near*nearK.
issues.fix: l.282-291: accept opts.divider and use DH = 0.70 + (opts.divider ?? 0) * (H - 0.70) for the centre side (keep 0.70 for the window skirt). Compute scx as in l.52 and place the screen at (scx, 0.965, -L + 0.141). Add one fCap gBox(w + 0.012, 0.04, 0.132) at y H + 0.0225 over the screen wall and gBox(0.16, 0.06, 0.86) over the wardrobe. Add flat gBox(0.012, H - 0.115, 0.50) fFlute panels at x hx + 0.004, z -L + 0.35 and -0.71 for the leaves, plus a 0.12-wide fWood box for the window wing. That is under 20 boxes.

issues.issue: Centre pier still projects narrow from the aisle: the 2D mirror is about 60 % of the real width relative to the screen, and the pier reads as a strip beside the screen, not the broad wood face of f32/f5.
issues.evidence: Mirror width/screen height: q02 0.22 (30/137 px) vs f32 0.37 (75/205). Pier/screen height: 0.36 vs ~0.9 (f32), and f5 2D pier ~190 px vs 235 px screen height. Inside the accepted 1.10 m width: pw = 0.19 at 70 deg.
issues.fix: Optional within the 1.10 constraint. l.78: centre pAng 70 -> 74 deg, so pw = 0.065/cos74 = 0.236. With the l.84 fix above, mW = min(0.13, 0.136) = 0.13. The pier depth grows to 0.227 (ends at z = -L+0.36, above the aisle box top 0.64 since the pier starts at y 0.645, see the low issue). Re-check the l.83 closing triangle.

issues.issue: Dashed dark seam down the aft edge of the centre fin (2D/2G). The two mirrored units' rounded edge strips meet back to back and leave a sub-pixel V-groove that aliases.
issues.evidence: q02 crop of the 2D/2G fin: a broken dark line between two taupe strips along the full fin height.
issues.fix: l.71-73: in centre mode let each half overlap the shared plane by 2 mm, so the groove is filled. Board: gRBox(0.014, ...) at x -hx + 0.005. Strips: gRBox(0.020, ...) at x -hx + 0.008. The coplanar overlap is inside the merged solid, so it is never seen.

issues.issue: Fluted-leaf moire at grazing angles (forward leaf in s1, q05): the 15 slats per leaf turn into a diamond mesh. The slat count is accepted, but the groove contrast drives the aliasing.
issues.evidence: s1 crop, forward leaf: a diamond/dot pattern. q05 crop: the forward leaf of the window suite reads as a perforated mesh.
issues.fix: Reduce the contrast instead of the count. In SEATMAT (09_seats.js, shared, one line each) set fFluteGap '#433c34' -> '#4a4538'. Then at l.209 give the slats a 0.0045 depth with a darker 0.002 side shading only if needed. The photo groove/slat ratio is about 0.7 (f60 shadowed groove vs face), not 0.75 hard black.

issues.issue: Uncovered wood flanks (closed and open variants) are too light against the fluted field, and the field is too warm. In f60 the flanks are near-black straight-grain and the field olive-taupe.
issues.fix: l.220: material { ...SEATMAT.fWood, c: '#2a221d' } for the flank faces only (the l.171 wardrobe face keeps fWood). Shared one-liner in 09_seats.js: fFlute '#5a5347' -> '#57554a'.

issues.issue: The pier's lower edge (0.62) dips 2 cm below the aisle-box top (0.64), so the wood shows a step behind the box top in q03.
issues.evidence: q03 crop: the pier bottom passes behind/into the box top surface.

issues.issue: The back channel seams render as LIGHT hairlines (fInner is lighter than the back). The real seams are dark creases.
issues.evidence: s4 crop: three bright lines. omaat_f9 / f13: shadowed horizontal creases.

issues.issue: Bed: the belt sits half under the lavender pillow, so one strap reads as a standing black block. The turned-down duvet corner is a 0.014 hairline triangle.
issues.evidence: q04 crop: a black block between the pillow and the armrest. f57: the belt lies fully exposed across the mid-bed, diagonally from the aisle edge. In q04 the corner is just a diagonal line.
issues.fix: l.254: bz -0.70 -> -0.92 (the pillow spans z -0.66..-0.38), ba 10 -> 25 deg. l.252: extrude depth 0.014 -> 0.03 and colour '#f6f5f1' so the fold catches light; optionally add a gCyl r 0.015 roll along the hypotenuse.

issues.issue: The niche header is still thin (0.075) with square inner corners.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9: header ~0.13 with ~0.06 inner fillets; s4.
issues.fix: As in w6b: l.238 plus two quarter-round gExtrude fillets (r 0.06, fConsole) at x = seatX +/- SW/2, y = H - 0.075.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: the keypad flares to 1.6x the console in q04 (sun LUT/specular on the tilted panel), and the sun patches on the bed are hard-edged. The q02 caps read blue-grey from sky light.
issues.evidence: q04 keypad 198 vs console 122; q02 cap #7c8e97.
issues.fix: Lighting/integration owner; on the suite side, keypad r 0.45 -> 0.6 at l.144 would soften the specular.

questions: omaat_f13 (looking aft over row 1's screen wall) shows the 1D/1G fins as two dark-wood boards with taupe edges splaying into a V that opens FORWARD, about 0.15-0.2 m apart at the screen wall, with the lowered divider/keypad spine between them. The w5 single in-plane board matches f32/f33 from the aisle. Should the fin go back to two boards, each angled ~8-10 deg out from the divider line, with a gap? The w4 version read as a post because it was a closed wedge, not two thin boards.
Centre pier: is a steeper 74 deg pier (pw 0.236) acceptable, given that it then faces the seat more and the aisle less?
